title: note.created
description: Creates a note. The note's `type` is not carried: every replica copies note_type.base_type. Omitted optional properties take the column default and get no clock. OPS.md#notecreated

id.description: Id of the new note. Equals the envelope's entity_id.

note_type_id.description: Note type; must exist (may be tombstoned). Immutable.

language.description: BCP 47 tag; always 'ja' in v1. Default 'ja'.

entry_seq.description: Dictionary entry this vocab note studies; only allowed when the note type's base_type is vocab. Default null. Register 'entry_seq'.

kanji_literal.description: The single kanji (one Unicode code point) a kanji note studies; only for base_type kanji. Immutable. Default null.

grammar_point_id.description: Grammar point a grammar note studies; only for base_type grammar; must exist. Immutable. Default null.

fields.description: Field values {field key: HTML fragment}. Each key is its own register 'fields.<key>'. Keys need not exist in the note type (unknown keys are kept).

source_sentence.description: Sentence the note was mined from, by value; '' if none. Register 'source_sentence' covers this and the two columns below.

source_sentence_id.description: Soft reference to sentence.id, or null.

source_media_id.description: Soft reference to media.id, or null.

origin.description: How the note was created: manual, takoboto, yomitan, ankiconnect, share, reader, deck, jpdb_import, api, auto_kanji. Open set. Immutable. Default 'manual'.
